title: Keep the denominator visible
code:
from capstone_lab import compare, load_case
metrics = compare(load_case())["implementations"]
for mode, values in metrics.items():
    historical = values["historical"]["numeric_parity"]
    online = values["online"]["raw_policy_parity"]
    print(mode)
    for measure in (historical, online):
        print(measure["numerator"], measure["denominator"],
              measure["excluded"], measure["population"])

title: Persist and verify retained artifacts
code:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from capstone_lab import load_case, persist_run, verify_artifacts
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / "run"
    written = persist_run(load_case(), path)
    checked = verify_artifacts(path)
    manifest = json.loads((path / "manifest.json").read_text())
    print(written == checked, checked["artifacts_verified"])
    print(manifest["training_boundary"]["artifact_kind"])

title: Replay reordered source deliveries
code:
from dataclasses import replace
from random import Random
from capstone_lab import load_case, run_case
from foundations_lab import Ledger
case = load_case("challenge")
rows = list(case.ledger.deliveries) * 3
Random(1010).shuffle(rows)
replayed = replace(case, ledger=Ledger(tuple(rows)))
print(run_case(case) == run_case(replayed))

title: Reject corrupted retained content
code:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from capstone_lab import CapstoneError, canonical, load_case
from capstone_lab import persist_run, verify_artifacts
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / "run"
    persist_run(load_case(), path)
    file = path / "improved_dataset.json"
    rows = json.loads(file.read_text())
    rows[0]["value"] = 51
    file.write_text(canonical(rows))
    try:
        verify_artifacts(path)
    except CapstoneError as error:
        assert str(error).startswith("artifact content mismatch:")
        print(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("corruption went undetected")
